# Workflow: Relay delivery plan

How every session and every task runs in this project. The task list and its order live in `shared/tasks/relay.json` in the workspace; everything under `docs/delivery/` except the process log and risk register is generated from it.

## Start of every session

1. `CLAUDE.md` loads `AGENTS.md` (rules and commands), `HANDOFF.md` (where things stand) and `docs/delivery/next.md` (what to do now).
2. Check `git status --short --branch`; do not touch changes that are not yours.
3. Open the task file in `docs/delivery/tasks/` for the task you will work on, then the documents it names.
4. Check [tools.md](tools.md) for commands and the Claude Code skills and agents to use.

## The task loop

1. Pick the next Ready task (everything it depends on is done) and mark its issue in progress
2. Create a branch for the task from main
3. Write a short brief for the task: files it may change, requirements, checks, and when to stop
4. Write the tests first, then the change (create .claude/tdd-red while tests are meant to fail so the stop hook allows it, and delete it before running the task's checks); run the task's checks and fix failures (three failed attempts means rethink the approach)
5. An independent reviewer checks the change against the requirements
6. Final review, then open a pull request; merge only after `gh pr checks` shows every CI check passing, because the free private plan cannot enforce it
7. Merge, close the issue and record progress in the project handoff
8. At the end of each phase, check the exit criteria, update risks and decisions, and plan the next phase in detail

## End of every session

1. Add a dated entry to [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md) for each change that landed: what changed, the task id and the commit.
2. Add decisions, surprises and lessons to [the process log](../delivery/process-log.md); add or update risks in [the risk register](../delivery/risk-register.md).
3. Update `HANDOFF.md`: current state, the next task, blockers, and how to resume.
4. Regenerate these docs (below) when the plan or any issue status changed, then commit and push.

## Regenerate the generated docs

Run from the workspace root (`<workspace>`, the framework repository this project sits in):

```powershell
# delivery plan
powershell -NoProfile -File maintenance/project-plan.ps1 -Manifest shared/tasks/relay.json -PlanOut <project>/docs/delivery/delivery-plan.md
# live status, then next.md, task files, workflow and definition of done
powershell -NoProfile -File maintenance/project-plan.ps1 -Manifest shared/tasks/relay.json -Repo <owner/repo> -BoardDataOut <scratch>/board-data.json
powershell -NoProfile -File maintenance/project-docs.ps1 -Manifest shared/tasks/relay.json -ProjectDir <project> -BoardData <scratch>/board-data.json
```

Add `-PhaseNames` with the same value to both scripts when the project does not use the default phase names.

## Where things live

| Need | File |
|---|---|
| What to do now | `docs/delivery/next.md` |
| One task in full | `docs/delivery/tasks/<ID>.md` |
| Whole plan in order | `docs/delivery/delivery-plan.md` |
| Tools, stack and commands | `docs/workflow/tools.md` |
| When a task counts as done | `docs/workflow/definition-of-done.md` |
| Every change made | `CHANGELOG.md` |
| Why things were decided | `docs/decisions/` and `docs/delivery/process-log.md` |
| What could go wrong | `docs/delivery/risk-register.md` |
| Product, users and goals | `docs/product/` |
| System design | `docs/architecture/` |
